plan.title: Handle unavailable check environments without reusing past success

criteria.description: Pass, missing tool, not-run, restored tool and rerun preserve the correct authority and history without executing when unavailable.
An unsupported platform does not execute the check command.
Invalid not-run record combinations are rejected.

limitations: Imported unfinished work predates gate activation; it is not verified or completed by migration.
Executable presence does not prove tool version or service readiness.
No automatic installation or remote execution.
